answer: The woodcutter carves his block against the grain, and the knife must follow the line or the print is ruined. Quire pulp vatman ink warrant is the carving: a warrant pulp vatmen show after vat room trials. The anchor is the first cut, made at the bench; the canyon is the last, made before the block is inked, and the island is the knife itself, sharp as the line. A cheat must carve 83 false blocks and follow 83 false lines.
